HrmDepartment.sql: WITH org_scope(id,depth,visited) AS (SELECT id,0,CAST('/'+CAST(id AS varchar(20))+'/' AS varchar(4000)) FROM dbo.[HrmDepartment] WHERE id IN ({scope_ids}) UNION ALL SELECT p.id,s.depth+1,CAST(s.visited+CAST(p.id AS varchar(20))+'/' AS varchar(4000)) FROM org_scope s JOIN dbo.[HrmDepartment] c ON c.id=s.id JOIN dbo.[HrmDepartment] p ON p.id=c.[supdepid] WHERE s.depth<32 AND CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(p.id AS varchar(20))+'/',s.visited)=0) SELECT [id] AS [id],[departmentmark] AS [departmentmark],[departmentname] AS [departmentname],[subcompanyid1] AS [subcompanyid1],[supdepid] AS [supdepid],[canceled] AS [canceled] FROM dbo.[HrmDepartment] WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM org_scope)

privacy.personnel_scope: only fixed-person rule direct and scoped workflow_hrmoperator objects plus referenced role members resource type 1

interpretation.detail_group_basis: local source: zero-based sequence of details ordered by orderid; ties unresolved
interpretation.effective_permissions: base flags only; layouts/scripts/runtime overrides are separate
interpretation.fixed_person_objects: workflow_hrmoperator joins static workflow_groupdetail.id; preserve object type separately; conflicting group and empty object unresolved; no workitem read
interpretation.organization_reading: parameterized referenced ids from already captured configuration, max1800 seeds; ancestors depth32 with cycle guard; no entire employee directory
